articles.title: TSX Dividend Stocks To Watch In January 2026
articles.mainIdea: TSX Dividend Stocks To Watch In January 2026
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: TSX Dividend Stocks To Watch In January 2026. In the face of geopolitical tensions and policy shifts, the Canadian market has shown remarkable resilience, with the TSX reaching record highs thanks to solid fundamentals such as low energy prices and moderating inflation. As we enter January 2026, dividend stocks continue to be an attractive option for investors seeking stability and income in a market anchored by robust economic growth and broadening earnings. Related tickers mentioned: BMO, CM, FCMGF, GRWTF, OLYFF, PLSDF, PWCDF, RSGUF, TCLAF, WCPRF.

articles.title: TD wins BIG Innovation Awards for fifth consecutive year
articles.mainIdea: TD wins BIG Innovation Awards for fifth consecutive year
articles.summary: CNW Group: TD wins BIG Innovation Awards for fifth consecutive year. For the fifth consecutive year, TD Bank Group (TD) was recognized by the Business Intelligence Group (BIG) through the 2026 BIG Innovation Awards. The Big Innovation Awards honour individuals, teams and organizations that paved a way for new products, services and experiences.
